name: Jane App vs TherapyNotes
title: Jane App vs TherapyNotes: Practice Management Comparison 2026
description: Compare Jane App and TherapyNotes for mental health practices. See pricing, features, and key differences between these popular EHR platforms for therapists.

summary.bottom_line: TherapyNotes is purpose-built for behavioral health with clinician-designed templates and 24/7 support, making it ideal for US-based mental health practices. Jane App excels for multi-disciplinary clinics and Canadian practices, but lacks mental health-specific features that TherapyNotes offers.

sections.heading: Jane App vs TherapyNotes: Overview
sections.content: Jane App and TherapyNotes serve different primary audiences. TherapyNotes was built specifically for behavioral health professionals by a clinical psychologist and web developer, featuring clinician-designed templates for mental health documentation. Jane App, built in Canada, serves a broader healthcare audience including physical therapists, chiropractors, massage therapists, and mental health practitioners. While both can work for therapists, TherapyNotes offers more specialized mental health features.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Jane App starts at $54/month for up to 20 appointments (Balance plan), with unlimited appointments at $79/month (Practice plan). TherapyNotes starts at $69/month with unlimited appointments included. Jane's AI Scribe is more affordable at $15/month vs TherapyNotes' TherapyFuel at $40/month. US insurance billing is native to TherapyNotes at $0.14/claim, while Jane requires a $20/month add-on for US billing. For Canadian practices, Jane has native Telus Health integration.

sections.heading: Mental Health Feature Differences
sections.content: TherapyNotes excels in behavioral health-specific features with interactive note templates designed by clinicians for progress notes, treatment plans, and psychiatric documentation. Jane App uses more generic clinical note templates that work across specialties but aren't optimized for mental health workflows. TherapyNotes also integrates with Office Ally clearinghouse for streamlined US insurance billing, while Jane's US billing capabilities are more limited.

sections.heading: Support & Service
sections.content: TherapyNotes offers 24/7 phone and email support - a significant advantage for practices that need after-hours assistance. Jane App provides business hours support but is known for award-winning customer service (2026 Silver Stevie Award). TherapyNotes offers free data import from other EMRs. Jane App is ideal for multi-disciplinary clinics where different provider types share one system.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Your choice depends on your practice type and location:

recommendations.when: You're a US-based mental health practice wanting purpose-built behavioral health features, clinician-designed note templates, and 24/7 support
You're a Canadian practice needing native Canadian billing and PIPEDA compliance, or a multi-disciplinary clinic with physical therapists, chiropractors, and therapists
You bill US insurance heavily and want seamless clearinghouse integration at competitive per-claim pricing
You want the most affordable AI scribe add-on ($15/month vs $40/month)

faqs.q: Is Jane App or TherapyNotes better for therapists?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes is generally better for US-based therapists due to its purpose-built behavioral health features, clinician-designed note templates, and native US insurance billing. Jane App is better for Canadian therapists or multi-disciplinary practices.

faqs.q: Which has better US insurance billing?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes has better US insurance billing with native integration, Office Ally clearinghouse, and $0.14 per-claim pricing. Jane App requires a $20/month add-on for US insurance billing and was originally designed for Canadian billing workflows.

faqs.q: Can Jane App work for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Yes, Jane App can work for mental health practices, but its templates and features are more generic compared to TherapyNotes' behavioral health-specific tools. Jane is better suited for multi-disciplinary clinics or Canadian mental health practices.

faqs.q: Which has better support: Jane App or TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes offers 24/7 phone and email support, while Jane App provides business hours support. For after-hours assistance, TherapyNotes has the advantage. However, Jane App has won awards for customer service quality.
